guitar.notes: Munky and Head are both well documented Ibanez 7-string signature artists (K7/APEX/HSH series), iconic to nu-metal sound.

tone.target: tight detuned nu-metal riff with mid-scooped high gain
tone.profile: tight detuned nu-metal riff with mid-scooped high gain
tone.summary: High-gain, tight distortion chain utilizing the Recti amp model and a 4x12 cab to achieve deep, scooped nu-metal tones with aggressive palm-muting.
corrections: Replace fuzz with tight high-gain distortion

rig.name: Korn - Freak On A Leash - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and excessive noise from high-gain riffing.
Add aggressive punch and tighten the attack for palm-muted riffs.
blocks.gap: No dedicated tight boost, using general Boost module to enhance pick attack.

blocks.purpose: Provide high-gain saturation and aggressive edge required for nu-metal.
Simulate the massive, scooped sound profile of modern metal amps.

blocks.purpose: Provide a robust and punchy 4x12 cabinet sound suitable for heavy riffs.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scoop the mids and control low-end mud while maintaining high definition.

blocks.purpose: No modulation needed; keep the tone dry and percussive.
Add subtle rhythmic depth without washing out the tight riffing.
